purpose: Teach: ピクセル/後味/サビ/霞/無防備/お嬢様/遭う/たった今

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、ピクセル、絶対、アートのロゴ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: Aoi, I really do think your store's pixel-art logo is absolutely lovely.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Slight emphasis on 「本気で」 conviction. Soft, unhurried pace. The tone of someone sharing a real observation, not flattering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。昨日の、本気で、絶対、お料理、絶対、後味、絶対、葵、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、引っかかっちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. Yesterday's food was really good, but something about the aftertaste kind of stuck with me.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Gentle delivery—not a complaint, more of a curious observation. Soft trailing on the verb. Warm despite the slight hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、好きな曲の、絶対、サビ、絶対、口ずさんでるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, you're always humming your favorite songs, especially the chorus part.
lines.style: Noticing, affectionate. Light, observant tone without judgment. Gentle pace. The warmth of someone who's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 朝の窓辺、本気で、絶対、霞、絶対、かかってて、絶対、葵、絶対、綺麗だと思ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: This morning by the window, with the mist like that, I thought you looked really beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, almost hesitant—admitting something she's been holding. Slow delivery. Breathiness beneath the words. The vulnerability of saying something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、無防備、絶対、な笑顔、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、可愛いと思うわ
lines.en: When you smile like that, unguarded—I think it's really cute.
lines.style: Direct but gentle. Slight pause before admitting it. Warm, sincere tone. No performance, just honesty. Soft on the final word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様、本気で、絶対、お嬢様、絶対、ぽい方、絶対、いらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You get a lot of elegant customers coming in here.
lines.style: Lighter, slightly playful observation. Warm and animated without being loud. Noticing something about Aoi's world, sharing it gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店で、絶対、楽しい人に、絶対、遭う、絶対、ことが、絶対、多いわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You meet so many wonderful people at the store, don't you?
lines.style: Cheerful, genuinely happy for her. Light, easy tone. The warmth of someone delighting in what brings someone else joy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: たった今、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、お客様、絶対、葵、絶対、ご来店、絶対、いただいたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Someone new came in just now.
lines.style: Bright, immediate. The warmth of sharing a small moment. Quick pace, forward-moving. The tone of someone glad to tell her something.
